<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 110

Hidden among the shadows and upper echelons of society are the conspirator dragons. These dragons are schemers, always looking to manipulate and control others, either for personal gain or simply for the thrill of watching their machinations play out. Conspirator dragons see themselves above others and typically speak with infantilizing tones and words. However, as most conspirator dragons meet others while in disguise, they do their best to maintain their disguise.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Conspirator Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2936) (Creature 12), [Ancient Conspirator Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2937) (Creature 17), [Young Conspirator Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2935) (Creature 8)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Conspirator Dragon Lairs</title>

While conspirator dragons keep hoards like other dragons, they also enjoy collecting secrets and extortion materials. These range from copies of letters, contracts thought to be secret, and other incriminating evidence that aid in achieving the dragon's goals. A given conspirator dragon's goals can be varied, and each keeps items related to this goal, such as deeds for a dragon looking to own a city or ancient tomes for a dragon looking to collect information on ancient civilizations. As most conspirator dragons live among settlements, they keep their hoards in large cellars, outside of the settlement in secretive forest or mountain lairs, or even in the vault of a local bank.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Conspirator Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Conspirator dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Conspirator Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 26, attack +19; **3rd** [_clairaudience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1465), [_paralyze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1622), [_veil of privacy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739); **2nd** [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458), [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577), [_paranoia_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1623); **1st** [_bane_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1447), [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1524), [_phantom pain_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1632); **Cantrips (3rd)** [_daze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1482), [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_figment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1598), [_telekinetic projectile_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1718) 

### Adult Conspirator Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 33, attack +26; As young conspirator dragon, plus **5th** [_scouting eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1661), [_synaptic pulse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1710), [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728); **4th** [_clairvoyance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1466), [_honeyed words_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1558), [_suggestion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1693); **Cantrips (5th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _figment_, _message_, _telekinetic projectile_ 

### Ancient Conspirator Dragon
 **Occult Prepared Spells** DC 39, attack +33; As adult conspirator dragon, plus **8th** [_hidden mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1556), [_unrelenting observation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1734); **7th** [_duplicate foe_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1505), [_project image_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1640), [_warp mind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1754); **6th** [_mislead_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1605), [_scrying_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1662), [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727); **Cantrips (8th)** _daze_, _detect magic_, _figment_, _message_, _telekinetic projectile_
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Vixalla</title>

Though she's a relatively recent arrival to the politics of Taldor, the Countess Phisetta dis Alavir has made quite the impression among the country's nobility. When not out in public, the Countess sheds her noble persona and takes on her true form, that of the conspirator dragon Vixalla. The dragon maintains her hoard and a rotation of servants whose memories she regularly wipes in a cavern deep beneath her manor in Taldor's capital of Oppara.
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
